QuestInfo.name: It's the Gift that Counts
QuestInfo.0: The townsfolk were awfully cold when you went to thank them. Maybe you did something wrong. Ask Silver.
QuestInfo.1: Silver says they're upset because you didn't give them a gift in return. Expecting a gift in return for gifts seems like a weird concept, but it must be a fox thing. Get something to give to the foxes.
QuestInfo.2: You prepared some gifts for the foxes. Everything worked out, but life in this village seems like a bit of a pain.

0.0: Ahh, you're wondering about how cold everyone is. Why, that's simple. You didn't get them a gift in return.
0.1: It's tradition for us to give a little something when we get something. If you get a steak, it's only natural to give a slice or two back.
0.2: Relax, no one's going to eat you over this. You're an outsider. They understand. It's still not too late to make up for it, either.

yes.0: You already ate your gift, of course, and you're too weak to get anything big, but some #r#t4009222##k items will do. Let's say, oh, 20?

no.0: We are very kind and generous, but don't let misunderstandings like this go on. You should at least prepare a little something in return.

1.0: Did you get the gifts yet? Let's not take too long with this.

yes.0: You're really not the smoothest talker, so let me take care of this. I'll give out these #t4009222#s for you. Don't worry about a thing.

default.0: Where are those #r#t4009222##ks? You should hurry. Better late than never, but everyone has their limits.
